notes.title: Version 0.3 is finally here!
notes.content:
Well... That escalated quickly...

What was supposed to be a smaller update, ended up being a major one. One of the main reasons behind that is the new Battle Editor!

I am really excited to see how this update is received :)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40956026/b6269816053df0eb96a475469b9582c5d876b3cf.gif

Changelog:

New stuff

Battle Editor - Brand new editor. Create your own maps, with all the features that are used for development. The editor will be updated along with the main game.
New sub-menu for the Battle Editor where you can create, edit, play and delete custom battles.
Cycle unused units - Pressing "Tab" will now allow you to cycle through all unused units.
Camera edge moving


Changed

All units now have their own lists for handling moves, attacks and skills. Before the lists were shared, and then reset between unit selection.
Changed the parameters that checks if a unit is used or not. This does still not check skills, but that is planned.
Camera is now centered on the battlefield on launch.


Fixed

Fixed a bug where the SituationState script caused a crash
Fixed a bug where the Charge skill would fail to set tiles properly
Fixed a bug in the Editor draw event
Fixed a lot of bugs relating to the switch to local move, attack and skill lists
Fixed a bug where the Swap skill didn't set the moves after use
Fixed a bug where the selected unit marker was not drawn on top
Fixed a bug where the Enemy AI would try to attack a nonexistent unit, causing all sorts of trouble
A lot of minor fixes and tweaks...

notes.title: Putting out fires left and right (bug fixing)
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40956026/680e553ab461e286091138f48761e2f9047fb8fc.gif


 Fixed the UI unit hover Box crash
 Fixed the bug that caused units to get stuck, and locking the turn
 Fixed bug in the script that handles enemy movement
 Fixed the script that removes duplicated items in a list
 Corrected multiple typos
 Fixed the mouse state not setting when hovering on UI elements, causing the player to interact with the wrong stuff
 Arrows now just hit the ground, if their target is killed while in flight
 Lots of smaller things
